top.title: Dubai Metro station to home in a driverless pod? RTA studies new transport routes
top.teaser: Dubai is studying plans to connect Metro stations with residential neighbourhoods, business districts and tourist attractions using driverless electric pods. The proposed routes are part of the Roads and Transport Authority's (RTA) Dubai Glydways project, which aims to make it easier for commuters to reach their final destinations through direct, on-demand transport. top.impact_reason: Better community transit links enhance residential property appeal.
top.headline: RTA studies driverless pods to connect metro stations and homes
top.summary: Dubai is exploring autonomous electric pods to link metro stations with residential and business areas. This initiative forms part of the Dubai Glydways project.
top.why: Improved community transit connectivity directly boosts the appeal and accessibility of residential neighborhoods.

top.title: UAE turns to AI to fight fires: Find out how it will save residents, firefighters and protect properties

top.headline: UAE adopts artificial intelligence to improve firefighting response
